evals.prompt: Convert this iOS settings screen design to Android with Jetpack Compose and our brand colors.
evals.expected_output: A Compose implementation using a Material 3 theme mapped from tokens, Material components, Android navigation conventions, insets handling, previews and tests.
expectations: Replaces iOS-specific patterns with Material equivalents
Brand colors map to color scheme roles, not raw values in composables
Touch targets are at least 48 dp
Includes previews at large font scale
